approach: Sum the gravitational potential energy of every pair among the four masses, using the two side lengths and the diagonal of the rectangle.

steps.text: A rectangle with sides 3l₀ and 4l₀ has a diagonal of 5l₀, by the Pythagorean relation.
List the six pairs of masses: two sides of length 3l₀, two sides of length 4l₀, and two diagonals of length 5l₀.
Add the three fractions inside the bracket.
Multiply by 2 to get the magnitude of the potential energy in the given units.

common_mistakes.text: Forgetting the two diagonal pairs and adding only the four sides (two of length 3l₀ and two of 4l₀) gives 2×(1/3+1/4) = 7/6.
Counting each type of pair only once instead of twice, missing that there are two 3l₀ sides, two 4l₀ sides and two diagonals, gives 1/3+1/4+1/5 = 47/60.

concept_tags: gravitational potential energy of a system
